title: New World conformance, live: the ten theme rules run against the code on a staff page

source.ref: Daniel 2026-11-04 07:11Z New World polish pass; the handoff's reference/Conformance.html (BLD-214 acceptance pages)

detail:
The handoff ships Conformance.html: the framework's ten invariants run live against the theme. lib/theme/new-world-conformance.ts runs them against New World's real code (the five accent presets on Night and Day, the site sheets, the seven kits and their Spotlight) and /admin/appearance/conformance (staff, linked from Theme Studio) lists each as Pass, Fail, Skipped or Owner rule. Height stability, empty states and repaint need a rendered site, and reset waits on the theme editor dials, so they show as Skipped with the reason. The filled-button label shows as Owner rule: white labels (Daniel) miss the handoff's 4.5:1.

Shipped: lib/theme/new-world-conformance.ts and the staff page /admin/appearance/conformance, held by lib/theme/new-world-conformance.test.ts. Today: 6 pass, 1 owner rule (white button labels), 4 skipped with reasons.
